Ravi Kumar
ravi.kumar@example.com | +91 98765 43210 | Hyderabad

SUMMARY
Front-end developer with 6 years of experience building web applications for payments and retail companies.

EXPERIENCE
Acme Payments, Senior Developer, 2021 to present
- Built customer screens in ReactJS and TS used by 2 million customers
- Responsible for the reporting screens that show payment data to merchants
- Cut page load time by 40% through performance work
- Wrote automated tests with Jest for every new component
- Set up pipelines on Jenkins for continuous integration and delivery
- Mentor for three junior developers

Shopline Retail, Developer, 2018 to 2021
- Worked on the checkout pages for the online store using JavaScript and Redux
- Built reusable form components shared by 4 teams
- Fixed accessibility issues found in an external audit

EDUCATION
B.Tech in Computer Science, JNTU Hyderabad, 2018

SKILLS
JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML, CSS, Git, Jenkins
cases.job:
Senior Frontend Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js and TypeScript. You will build dashboards for our payments platform and mentor junior engineers. Experience with Next.js, GraphQL and CI/CD pipelines is required. Knowledge of Node.js and AWS is a plus.

Responsibilities: own dashboards end to end, improve performance of the payments dashboards, write unit testing suites with Jest, and mentor engineers. You care about accessibility and responsive design.
